findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: Observed that in the public bar there were unwrapped straws that were available for customers to handle. CORRECTED: PICs were notified that unwrapped straws should only be handled using a barrier, either with gloved hands or by replacing the straws with ith wrapped straws, so that the food-contact surfaces of the straws are safe from potential contamination from barehands. PICs discarded the unwrapped straws. Facility will only use wrapped straws from now on. Ensure ready-to-eat food-contact surfaces are protected from contamination from barehands by using a barrier.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT. [P]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
Observed that the public bar and members-only bar do not have dedicated handwashing sinks:
* The public bar does have a triple sink for warewashing. 
* The members-only bar only has a double sink. 
PICs were notified that separate dedicated handwashing must be available for convenient use by employees and volunteers in areas where food and beverage preparation and dispensing occurs. 
PICs and Inspector discussed changing the sinks to be used only for handwashing and general preparation; items that need to be warewashed would be taken to the kitchen (a different room) where warewashing facilities exist (a large triple sink designated for warewashing):
* Public Bar: one compartment would be for handwashing only (complete with handwashing sign, hand soap, paper towels) and the other two compartments would be used for general prep activities e.g. dump sink, water filling, fruit washing, etc. (complete with signs).
* Members-only Bar: one compartment would be for handwashing only (complete handwashing sign, hand soap, paper towels) and the other compartment would be used for general prep activities (complete with sign).
PICs will confirm with Inspector when these changes have been made. 
Ensure handwashing sinks are available for convenient use during food and beverage preparation and dispensing.
findings.citation_text: 5-204.11 Handwashing Sinks. A HANDWASHING SINK shall be located: (A) To allow convenient use by EMPLOYEES in FOOD preparation, FOOD dispensing, and WAREWASHING areas; and (B) In, or immediately adjacent to, toilet rooms. [Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed that the sanitizer bucket made with bleach had a too low concentration of Chlorine (10ppm). CORRECTED: PIC was notified, and added more sanitizer to the solution until it measured at a safe and effective concentration of Chlorine (50ppm). PIC and Inspector discussed that given the size of the bucket, 4 capfuls of sanitizer may be needed, and should be confirmed with test strips for Chlorine (see Violation #48). Ensure that sanitizer solutions are used per manufacturer’s instructions, and measure at safe and effective concentrations of sanitizer: 50-200ppm for Chlorine-based sanitizers like bleach.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed that the ice machine was heavily soiled on the inside. PICs were notified, and will have it cleaned. PICs SHALL remove the ice machine from service until it is cleaned AND the Inspector has confirmed that the ice machine has been sufficiently cleaned to sight and touch. Ensure that food-contact surfaces and equipment are cleaned with enough frequency that they are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed that the interior panel of the ice machine was previously repaired with duct tape, which is failing. PIC was notified. The ice machine must be repaired with a material that is smooth and easily cleanable.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed an accumulation of soils on the floor next to the cabinets of the public bar. PIC was notified. Ensure that nonfood-contact surfaces are cleaned a frequency to prevent an accumulation of soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed that a mop was improperly stored between uses, sitting in the lower basin of a mop bucket submerged in water instead of hanging in the upper basket where it can drip-dry and air-dry. CORRECTED: PICs were notified, and the mop was moved to air-dry. Ensure that mops are allowed to air-dry between uses, either in the upper basket of the mop bucket or hanging above a mop sink, to prevent potential harborage for pests and pathogens.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no stem thermometer available in the facility. A second follow-up will be conducted at the next event taking place on July 5, 2026 to ensure availability.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small-diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Inspector observed shelled eggs stored over drinks in the cooler. CORRECTED: eggs were moved to the bottom shelf. Ensure raw products are stored below ready-to-eat foods.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Facility was unable to find a full scale thermometer (lowest = 50 F, meat thermometer). Obtain a stem thermometer that can be calibrated using the ice method. An inspector will return for a future event on 7 June 2026 OR the facility can send the inspector a picture of their stem thermometer that has a minimum temperature reading of 32 F.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.12 Food Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures as specified under Chapter 3. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small-diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Facility did not have test strips for sanitizer. CORRECTED: strips were obtained. Ensure a test kit is available to verify proper sanitizing concentration (Chlorine = 50-200ppm).
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Sliced tomatoed were observed to have an internal temperature of 51 F. CORRECTED: use time as control (use or discard within 4 hours if temperature cannot be maintained below 41 F).
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Observed the mop sink is not sealed to the wall. Ensure that the mop sink is sealed to the wall (ex.caulking) to make a smooth, easily cleanable surface by the next routine inspection. 

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent; (C) Sufficient in weight and thickness to withstand repeated WAREWASHING; (D) Finished to have a SMOOTH, EASILY CLEANABLE surface; and (E) Resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Observed the standing freezer was at 37F when the inspector arrived. The PIC stated there was most likely an issue with the scheduled defrost. The freezer was observed in temperature the night before. The ice inside the freezer was still frozen indicating it had not been above freezing for long. The PIC adjusted the temperature and it went down to 30F during the inspection. The PIC was instructed to closely monitor the temperature. The inspector will return on 11/22/2024 to ensure that the freezer is functioning correctly. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION: Observed the mop room with the coffee pots has an outlet along the wall that is in need of attention (the outlet has a sign above it that says not to use). The outlet does not have a plate and is an exposed cavity in the wall. The outlet needs to be either fixed or plated off to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. Ensure attention is received to maintain physical facilities in good repair by the next routine inspection. 

6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
